risk_note: Gate tooling only (CT-06zzzzzzzd, D10-2698 甲 / D10-2709; owner agreed 2026-11-23 14:49). A modify_existing whole-block entry may now name a frozen .each / .for block whose title is a template literal with ${…} (e.g. inside a for (const source of sources) loop) by its source text between the backticks, verbatim (placeholders, %s, escapes and blanks as written). A plain it / test with such a title is never a whole block; a placeholder spelt otherwise or expanded to a value names nothing; two blocks of one text are refused; templates without interpolation keep the cooked-value behaviour; whole-block entries still require rule_change and a note (tighten_only refused). Only tools/guard/lib/test-blocks.ts and its unit test change. Unblocks B2-19 (its frozen TIME#2 .each block in a for loop).
